pages.text: Taro liked surprising people. Yesterday, he hid behind leaves. The day before, he hid behind a water jug.
"Today, I'll give Mumu a really big surprise!" Taro slipped under the porch. When Mumu came, he would shout, "Boo!"
Mumu arrived. "Taro?" No one was on the porch.
Mumu thought Taro had not arrived yet. Mumu sat on the porch to wait, swinging their feet.
Under the porch, Taro watched those feet. "I'll wait a little longer before I surprise them." He held his breath.
It was cool and quiet beneath the porch. Taro squeezed his eyes shut to keep from laughing. His shoulders shook.
Mumu stood up. "I'll wait at the stream." Mumu's footsteps were very quiet.
Taro opened his eyes. The feet were gone! "Where did Mumu go?"
Taro crawled out. No one was on the porch or in the yard. He ran to the stream.
Mumu popped out of the grass. "Boo!" Taro shrieked. But Taro had been the one planning the surprise!
